pairs: In diebus autem illis venit Joannes Baptista prædicans in deserto Judææ,
Now in those days, John the Baptist arrived, preaching in the desert of Judea,
For the kingdom of heaven has drawn near.”
For this is the one who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah,
qui dictus est per Isaiam prophetam dicentem:
“A voice crying out in the desert:
Prepare the way of the Lord.
Ipse autem Joannes habebat vestimentum de pilis camelorum,
Now the same John had a garment made from the hair of camels,
et zonam pelliceam circa lumbos suos:
and a leather belt around his waist.
and the entire region around the Jordan went out to him.
et baptizabantur ab eo in Jordane,
And they were baptized by him in the Jordan,
and Sadducees arriving for his baptism,
quis demonstravit vobis fugere a ventura ira?
who warned you to flee from the approaching wrath?
Therefore, produce fruit worthy of repentance.
Et ne velitis dicere intra vos:
And do not choose to say within yourselves,
Dico enim vobis quoniam potens est Deus de lapidibus istis suscitare filios Abrahæ.
For I tell you that God has the power to raise up sons to Abraham from these stones.
Jam enim securis ad radicem arborum posita est. Omnis ergo arbor,
For even now the axe has been placed at the root of the trees. Therefore,
quæ non facit fructum bonum, excidetur, et in ignem mittetur.
every tree that does not produce good fruit shall be cut down and cast into the fire.
Ego quidem baptizo vos in aqua in pœnitentiam:
Indeed, I baptize you with water for repentance,
qui autem post me venturus est, fortior me est,
but he who will come after me is more powerful than me.
cujus non sum dignus calceamenta portare:
I am not worthy to carry his shoes.
ipse vos baptizabit in Spiritu Sancto, et igni.
He will baptize you with the fire of the Holy Spirit.
His winnowing fan is in his hand.
And he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor.
et congregabit triticum suum in horreum,
And he will gather his wheat into the barn.
But the chaff he will burn with unquenchable fire.”
Tunc venit Jesus a Galilæa in Jordanem ad Joannem,
Then Jesus came from Galilee, to John at the Jordan,
in order to be baptized by him.
“I ought to be baptized by you,
and yet you come to me?”
sic enim decet nos implere omnem justitiam.
For in this way it is fitting for us to fulfill all justice.”
et ecce aperti sunt ei cæli:
and behold, the heavens were opened to him.
et vidit Spiritum Dei descendentem sicut columbam,
And he saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove,
Et ecce vox de cælis dicens:
And behold, there was a voice from heaven,
in whom I am well pleased.”
